context: Daichi and Mei plan a trip to an island.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: travel planning; transport vocabulary (交通/料金/増加/直接/島) in natural home.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 今度、南の島に行かへん?
lines.en: Want to go to a southern island sometime?
lines.style: lively Kansai man voice, warm hearty inviting delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: いいですね。交通は、どうしましょう?
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle engaged delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 船やと、料金が安いんよ。
lines.en: By ship, the fare is cheap.
lines.style: cheerful Kansai man voice, warm friendly delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 島まで、直接行けるんですか?
lines.en: Can we go directly to the island?
lines.style: curious woman voice, gentle warm engaged delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: うん、直接行ける便があるで。
lines.style: lively Kansai man voice, warm reassuring delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 夏は、観光客が増加しますよね。
lines.style: thoughtful woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: そやな、増加する前に行こか。
lines.en: Right, let's go before they increase.
lines.style: cheerful Kansai man voice, warm friendly delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 交通の予約、早めにしておきますね。
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm reliable closing delivery throughout
